findings.summary: pos_state.dart exposes deleteProduct() which removes the product from in-memory state with no API call, silently bypassing the server's soft-delete semantics. The UI calls deactivateProduct() for all delete actions today, so no user-visible breakage exists, but the method is reachable and misleadingly named.
findings.action: Remove deleteProduct or add an API call matching deactivateProduct's behavior to avoid silent divergence.

findings.summary: The UUID regex in PosState.deactivateProduct uses [1-8] as the version nibble, accepting draft UUID v6-v8 in addition to standard v1-v5. Prisma generates v4, so this is harmless today but could gate unexpected IDs if the UUID generation strategy changes.
findings.action: Narrow to [1-5] to match RFC 4122 standard, or leave as-is with a comment explaining the intent.
